headline: Just POC'd Jev by @typesafeai on one of our live services and the results are crazy
text:
Just POC'd Jev by @typesafeai on one of our live services and the results are crazy 

 - 88% vs 76% accuracy
 - 5× faster
 - ~15× cheaper

vs the GPT setup we run in prod. Not an LLM, and it doesn't need to be.
